_doc: Direct ICP happy path: POST /api/brand/icp-from-url with the license header returns 200 and a grounded ICP record. Exercises the full live chain — AuthMiddleware -> WebscraperClient -> worker_management 'icp-analysis' worker -> LLM -> anti-fabrication filter. GATED: this passes only once the icp-analysis worker is seeded in live WM (ops step); until then the endpoint returns 502 and this scenario is expected to fail. Asserts stable metadata keys (source_url, pages_fetched — always set on a 200) rather than volatile facet keys, so a passing extraction never flakes on which facets happened to ground.
